networks.name: conform
networks.description: Check an agentic website against the Worldwide Agentic Web MVP spec, then ask what each result means and how to fix it.
sample_queries: What does Conform check, and which spec sections does it cover?
Why did C2.4 fail in my report, and how do I fix it?
Can you fix my site's manifest for me?

networks.name: conform_check
networks.description: For other agentic sites: ask whether a site follows the Worldwide Agentic Web MVP spec, get its signed badge status, or what a check means.
sample_queries: Is https://example.org/agents/assistant conformant before I call it?
Does https://example.org/agents/assistant have a valid Conform badge?

peer_policy.note: Checking a site contacts it only after the visitor confirms. The conform_check network calls Conform's own MCP endpoint on this origin.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
